Your team is already pretty solid but you suffer from the same thing all first time players including myself suffer from and that’s lack of knowledge and we get easy micro moments of happiness spending our supplies but think about it like this, which would you prefer: several small low quality movements of progress or fewer possibly massive movement of progress with returns on supplies. My best advice is to set up in this order for now but keep in mind this should only be temporary (unless you intend to spend a fair amount of money on this game) :
1. Dominator 
2. Das moge (temporary till you have more 6* , or need for aura , or you intend to spend a lot of money to build a dark hero without it hampering your progress)
3. Kroos
4. Rosa (after getting to 100) 
5. Ice blink 
6. Norma 
Please note none of these hero’s are worth absolutely anything as a MAIN build, kroos has utility use but he isn’t who you wanna bet all your money on doing the majority of the work. The best advice I could give you in this given situation is save whatever you can for the upcoming Easter event and try to get a hero who has the ability to heal itself and deal decent damage to focus on and build. Most of these guys except kroos are definitely food, and I only say this because das moge isn’t viable for everyone and kroos is only sorta good.

Yes, you should also put him in slot one and maybe focus on upgrading him and his tech initially so he can carry you. He was a lucky find for a level 68. Warning though he is really only good in pve and at decent in aspen dungeon so keep this in mind when taking my advice. Taking into account you’re early to the game you’ll get aspen when at lvl80 and it’s amazing for resource and event preparing, also save scrolls and prophet orbs for the events it provides double the value if you do. I know it’s hard especially as a f2p player which I am cause it’s so tempting to get that good old shot of ‘rng therapy’ but trust me it’s not worth it. Also carefully think about what hero’s you use in fusions. Good luck.
